headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.22
summary: The updater no longer locks itself out: a failed or cancelled download used to silence every future update check until the app was restarted.

items.text: The update dialog and download progress bar show up again after a failed or cancelled download. A stuck internal flag made the launcher silently skip every later update check, and an HTTP error page could even be mistaken for the update APK.
